title: Rishyashringa officiates the putrakameshti
introduction: King Dasharatha commences the putrakaameSTi ritual aiming to beget progeny, under the aegis of Sage Rishyasringa. The celestial beings gather to receive the oblations offered in the Horse Ritual conducted by King Dasharatha. They are perturbed at the atrocities of Ravana, and request Brahma to think for a way to eliminate Ravana. Vishnu arrives there and pacifies Brahma and other celestials with an assurance that he will incarnate as human to eliminate Ravana.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे पञ्चदशः सर्गः ||

verses.devanagari:
मेधावी तु ततो ध्यात्वा स किञ्चिदिदमुत्तरम् |
लब्धसंज्ञः ततस्तं तु वेदज्ञो नृपमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
medhāvī tu tato dhyātvā sa kiñcit idam uttaram |
labdha sañjñaḥ tataḥ tam tu vedajño nṛpam abravīt
verses.translation: That intellectual sage and one proficient in Veda-s Rishyasringa contemplated for a while, and gaining indications as to which ritual is to be performed, then said the king.

verses.devanagari:
इष्टिं तेऽहं करिष्यामि पुत्रीयां पुत्रकारणात् |
अथर्वशिरसि प्रोक्तैर्मन्त्रैः सिद्धां विधानतः
verses.iast:
iṣṭim te'ham kariṣyāmi putrīyām putra kāraṇāt |
atharva sirasi proktaiḥ mantraiḥ siddhām vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: "I will procedurally conduct the ritual contained in the preamble of adharva-veda with procedural hymns, called putra kaameSTi i.e., the ritual that bestows sons, for your benefit."

glosses.meaning: I, to you [for your benefit,] for sons, for the reason [to beget]
adharva Veda's, preamble, said in [contained in]
one that bestows sons [called putrakaameSTi ,] for begetting sons

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्राक्रमदिष्टिं तां पुत्रीयां पुत्रकारणात् |
जुहाव चाग्नौ तेजस्वी मन्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा
verses.iast:
tataḥ prākramat idam iṣṭim tām putrīyām putra kāraṇāt |
juhāva agnau ca tejasvī mantra dṛṣṭena karmaṇā
verses.translation: Then that resplendent Sage Rishyasringa commenced that putrakaameSTi ritual, offering oblations into sacred fire with ritual acts meticulously contained in hymns.

verses.devanagari:
ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः |
भागप्रतिग्रहार्थं वै समवेता यथाविधि
verses.iast:
tato devāḥ sa gandharvāḥ siddhāḥ ca parama ṛṣayaḥ |
bhāga pratigrahārtham vai samavetā yathāvidhi
verses.translation: Then the deities along with celestial beings, siddha-s, i.e., the souls that obtained salvation, and also other esteemed sages who by now are the residents of Heavens have duteously assembled in the firmament to receive their part of the oblations.
notes: These celestial beings having attained salvation and living in their heavenly abodes do not re-enter these mortal worlds. They assemble in their cosmic zone, up above the Fire Altar of the Vedic ritual whenever a yajna is conducted on earth, to receive oblations.

glosses.meaning: then, deities, siddha-s, also, esteemed, saints
their due [of oblations,] to receive, verily

verses.devanagari:
ताः समेत्य यथान्यायं तस्मिन् सदसि देवताः |
अब्रुवन् लोककर्तारं ब्रह्माणं वचनं ततः
verses.iast:
tāḥ sametya yathā nyāyam tasmin sadasi devatāḥ |
abruvan loka kartāram brahmāṇam vacanam tataḥ
verses.translation: Those deities who procedurally assembled there in that congregation then spoke to Brahma, the creator of worlds.

verses.devanagari:
भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन रावणो नाम राक्षसः |
सर्वान्नो बाधते वीर्याच्छासितुं तं न शक्नुमः
verses.iast:
bhagavan tvat prasādena rāvaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ |
sarvān no bādhate vīryāt śāsitum tam na śaknumaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh! God, the demon named Ravana is torturing all of us with his intrepidity, as you have blessed him, and we are unable to control him.

glosses.meaning: with your, blessings - as you have blessed him
him, to control, we are not, able to.

verses.devanagari:
त्वया तस्मै वरो दत्तः प्रीतेन भगवान् तदा |
मानयन्तश्च तं नित्यं सर्वं तस्य क्षमामहे
verses.iast:
tvayā tasmai varo dattaḥ prītena bhagavan tadā |
mānayantaḥ ca tam nityam sarvam tasya kṣamāmahe
verses.translation: "You have given boon to him appreciating his ascesis and oh, god, with high regard to that boon of yours we are tolerating all the cruel acts of Ravana from then onwards
notes: Hindu mythology has no devils, but has only rākśasa -s, who can hardly be called demons, either. Not all the raakshasa-s are evil-doers. Some of the raakshasa-s are the fallen angels who take birth as mortals. They have their Vedic education, and they perform Vedic rituals and penance etc., thereby they get the patronage of any one of the gods among the Hindu Trinity, viz., Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva. On attaining the cherished boons, they suddenly revolt against their own patron deities and commence the atrocities only to conquer the Heavens, knowing well that they cannot be attained with a mortal body. In order to snub the upsurge of such violence or the unnatural ascension to Heaven, the deity who gave the boons seeks the help of any of the other two of the Trinity. Then one from the Trinity will take birth as mortal, as an incarnation of god on earth. Usually Vishnu incarnates himself to eradicate the evils created by the intrepid rākśasa-s.

Here the celestials bring in a preamble for Vishnu's incarnation as Rama and thus the topic of Ravana occurs in this chapter of Ramayana. Ravana need not be taken as an evil spirit, devil, hobgoblin or a monstrous being. He is said to be a Brahman well versed in all Vedas, musicologist, and a great king of Lanka, with unlimited riches, and very many of his clansmen with their vast dominions, and what not. Though Brahma and Shiva bless Ravana with boons, Ravana flouts all the norms in conquering Heavens in which course he did not hesitate to torture anyone who becomes his personal hurdle or hindrance. Hence it is inevitable for the Trinity to curb Ravana's atrocities, and Vishnu will now be requested by all the deities to incarnate himself on earth. As such, the expression of the word "DEMON" may not always be taken as an ugly and monstrous looking devil or Satan, as per the usual religious conceptualisation of evil.

In Hinduism evil is not a separate entity from humans, but available in the same personification and resides along with virtue, like the two sides of a coin. These raakshasa-s are also mortals, extraordinary beings with extraordinary powers like god incarnates. But, with wickedness in their will, monstrosity in mind and a conqueror's ambition in their heart, they are rendered themselves as demons.

glosses.meaning: to him - Ravana, boons, given by you
all [his cruel acts,] of his [Ravana,] we are tolerating.

verses.devanagari:
उद्वेजयति लोकांस्त्रीनुच्छ्रितान् द्वेष्टि दुर्मतिः |
शक्रं त्रिदशराजानं प्रधर्षयितुमिच्छति
verses.iast:
udvejayati lokān trīn ucchritān dveṣṭi durmatiḥ |
śakram tridaśa rājānam pradharṣayitum icchati
verses.translation: "That malevolent Ravana is tormenting all the three worlds, hating the functionary deities of cosmos, and always desires to assail Indra, the king of all the functionary deities of universe.
notes: There are eight functionary gods for cosmos in Hindu mythology that keep the cycle of natural law going. Each one is assigned with each of the eight sides of the universe along with a natural function. They are: 1] Indra, Heaven : East, 2] agni Fire-god : southeast, 3] yama Death-god : South, 4] naiṛti Demon-god : southwest, 5] varuṇa Rain-god : west, 6] vāyu Air-god : Northwest, 7] kubera god of wealth management : North, 8] īeśāna god of bliss : Northeast. The governance of all these deities is Indra's function, since he is the presiding deity of Heaven.

glosses.meaning: functionary deities of cosmos, he is hating
celestial's, king of, Indra, to assail, desires to.

verses.devanagari:
ऋषीन् यक्षान् सगन्धर्वानसुरान् ब्राह्मणांस्तथा |
अतिक्रामति दुर्धर्षो वरदानेन मोहितः
verses.iast:
ṛṣīn yakṣān sa gandharvān asurān brāhmaṇān tathā |
atikrāmati durdharṣo vara dānena mohitaḥ
verses.translation: "That invincible one is further self-conceited by the boons you have accorded, and he is overbearingly torturing the sages, celestial beings like yaksha-s, gandharva-s, asura-s, and like that even the Brahmans.
notes: The sura and a-sura nomenclature is the one that is commonly found in Vedic literature. sura is a celestial being and asura is its antonym, usually referred as a demon. Here it is not so because there are many asura-s who made their abode in heaven, like Rahu, Ketu, and others who attain salvation in this mortal life. Even Ravana came from Heaven, and returns there only at the end of the war with Rama. Thus a-sura-s are not earthly demons but celestial beings of a kind like other demi-gods, namely yakśa, gandharva, kinnara, kimpuruśa etc.

glosses.meaning: by boon, given [by you,] becoming self-conceited he

verses.devanagari:
नैनं सूर्यः प्रतपति पार्श्वे वाति न मारुतः |
चलोर्मिमाली तं दृष्ट्वा समुद्रोऽपि न कंपते
verses.iast:
nainam sūryaḥ pratapati pārśve vāti na mārutaḥ |
calor.hmimālī tam dṛṣṭvā samudro'pi na kampate
verses.translation: "The Sun-god will not verily parch Ravana, the Air-god will not puff at his sides, and on seeing Ravana, the lord of the undulating waves, namly the ocean will not pulsate either.
notes: And ocean hides those undulating waves from Ravana for the waves are his wives whom Ravana may abduct as in the case of Seetha.

glosses.meaning: Air-god, at his sides, will not, puff
him [Ravana,] on seeing, will not, pulsate.

verses.devanagari:
तन्महन्नो भयं तस्माद्राक्षसाद्घोरदर्शनात् |
वधार्थं तस्य भगवन्नुपायं कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
tan mahanno bhayam tasmāt rākṣasāt ghora darśanāt |
vadhārtham tasya bhagavan upāyam kartum arhasi
verses.translation: "Thereby, there is a great panic for all of us from that demon with an awesome look, hence oh, god, it will be apt of you to give a thought for his elimination.

glosses.meaning: one awesome, for sight, from that, demon
for his, elimination, for purpose of
idea, to make, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तः सुरैः सर्वैः चिन्तयित्वा ततोऽब्रवीत् |
हन्तायं विदितस्तस्य वधोपायो दुरात्मनः
verses.iast:
evam uktaḥ suraiḥ sarvaiḥ cintayitvā tato'bravīt |
hantā ayam viditaḥ tasya vadhopāyo durātmanaḥ
verses.translation: When all the deities spoke to Brahma thus, he thought for a while and then said "Aha! The idea to kill that evil-minded Ravana is discerned.

glosses.meaning: by all, gods, this way, one who is spoken - Brahma
this is the, elimination, idea for

verses.devanagari:
तेन गन्धर्वयक्षाणां देवतानां च रक्षसाम् |
अवध्योऽस्मीति वागुक्ता तथेक्तं च तन्मया
verses.iast:
tena gandharva yakṣāṇām devatānām ca rakṣasām |
avadhyo'smi iti vāguktā tatheti uktam ca tan mayā
verses.translation: "Ravana said while seeking boon that, 'I shall not be killed by gandharva-s, yaksha-s, or by gods, or by other demons...' and I also said 'so be it..."

glosses.meaning: by gods, also, by other demons
not, killable, I shall be, thus

glosses.itrans: mayaa cha tat thata iti uktam
glosses.iast: mayā ca tat thata iti uktam
glosses.devanagari: मया च तत् थत इति उक्तं
glosses.meaning: by me, also, that, that way, thus, said.

verses.devanagari:
नाकीर्तयदवज्ञानात्तद्रक्षो मानुषांस्तदा |
तस्मात् स मानुषाद्वध्यो मृत्युर्नान्योऽस्य विद्यते
verses.iast:
na akīrtayat avajñānāt tat rakṣo mānuṣām tadā |
tasmāt sa mānuṣāt vadhyo mṛtyuḥ na anyo'sya vidyate
verses.translation: "That demon did not express about humans then with his disrespect to them, and evidently his death does not occur otherwise." So said Brahma to gods.

glosses.meaning: he, by human, can be killed
his] mR^ityuH na anyaH vidyate = death, not, otherwise, evident.

verses.devanagari:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा प्रियं वाक्यं ब्रह्मणा समुदाहृतम् |
देवा महर्षयः सर्वे प्रहृष्टास्तेऽभवंस्तदा
verses.iast:
etat śrutvā priyam vākyam brahmaṇā samudāhṛtam |
devā maharṣayaḥ sarve prahṛṣṭāḥ te abhavan tadā
verses.translation: On hearing Brahmathe explaining himself , then all those gods and great sages became adequately happy.

verses.devanagari:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विष्णुरुपयातो महाद्युतिः |
श्ङ्खचक्रगदापाणिः पीतवासा जगत्पतिः
वैनतेयं समारुह्य भास्करस्तोयदं यथा |
तप्तहाटककेयूरो वन्द्यमानः सुरोत्तमैः
verses.iast:
etasmin anantare viṣṇuḥ upayāto mahādyutiḥ |
śñkha cakra gadā pāṇiḥ pīta vāsā jagatpatiḥ
vainateyam samārūhya bhāskara toyadam yathā |
tapta hāṭaka keyūro vandyamānaḥ surottamaiḥ
verses.translation: In the meanwhile the great resplendent Vishnu, the Lord of the Universe, arrived there mounted on his Eagle-vehicle Garuda, handling conch-shell, disc, and mace in his three of four hands, clad in yellow-ochre robes, wearing golden bracelets, and while best gods eulogised him, and his arrival there is like the arrival of sun mounted on black cloud to accord the gratuitous gift called the rain.
notes: Vishnu is a four handed deity. He handles a Divine Lotus suggesting that he is the creator sṛṣṭi karta. An ever-cycling disc called sudarśana cakra is handled symbolising his ever-lasting dynamism. He is the maintainer of that continuous dynamism of already created Universe sthithi karta. A mace called kaumodakī for bludgeoning enemies as he is the eradicator of evil samhāra karta, and a conch-shell called pāncajanya which produces the sound of Om, listening to which salvation, mukti, is achieved by the true devotee. The sound of the same conch shell gives out an unbearable sound in respect of enemies. He is entered here without a lotus in hand. That means there is no need for a creation afresh. The other items he is handling are enough to deal with Ravana. If the Lotus is not handled that hand is taken as a blessing hand, abhaya hasta. And now he is giving that a + bhaya no fear, an assurance, to all gods.

The expression that Vishnu has come on his eagle-vehicle has a cross-reference to the previous chapter's garuḍa yajna vedi , Eagle-shaped Altar of Fire that is laid by priests of Dasharatha. It will be laid so with assumption that Garuda, also called suparṇa, the Divine Eagle will fly in to transport oblations. The Vedic ritual is also called su parṇa, the golden winged, or great winged vehicle to conduct oblations. And the eagle-vehicle of Vishnu is the quickest carrier of oblations to the deities specified in Vedic hymn. Here this Garuda has already carried the oblations offered by King Dasharatha to the chanting of Vedic hymns by Sage Rishyasringa to Vishnu. So Vishnu is now coming mounted on the same meritorious carrier, namely Garuda. Secondly the simile of Sun's coming mounted on a black cloud has some thing to do with yajna. A silver cloud is no value in giving rains. The rain has got an inseparable combination with Vedic ritual. Since the ritual of Dasharatha is going to fructify the rainfall is due on earth. Hence, the sun on collecting all the merits called the rituals of Dasharatha, in the form waters is coming riding on a black cloud to shower rains. Hence Vishnu and Sun both are ready now shower their graces. Vishnu will shower grace by eradicating the evil called Ravana, and the sun by showering the gratuitous and cooling rains.

glosses.meaning: Lady Vinata's son, GaruDa, mounted on
Sun, on water giver [sun on black cloud,] like
while eulogised, by gods, the best

verses.devanagari:
ब्रह्मणा च समागम्य तत्र तस्थौ समाहितः |
तमब्रुवन् सुराः सर्वे समभिष्टूय संनताः
verses.iast:
brahmaṇā ca samāgaṃya tatra tasthau samāhitaḥ |
tam abruvan surāḥ sarve samabhiṣṭūya saṃnatāḥ
verses.translation: Vishnu having met Brahma stood there contemplating, and then all of the gods on bowing down and offering prayers addressed Vishnu.

glosses.meaning: him, on offering prayers, said to him.

verses.devanagari:
त्वां नियोक्ष्यामहे विष्णो लोकानां हितकाम्यया |
राज्ञो दशरथस्य त्वमयोध्याधिपतेः विभोः
धर्मज्ञस्य वदान्यस्य महर्षिसमतेजसः |
अस्य भार्यासु तिसृषु ह्रीश्रीकीर्त्युपमासु च
विष्णो पुत्रत्वमागच्छ कृत्वात्मानं चतुर्विधम् |
verses.iast:
tvām niyokṣyāmahe viṣṇo lokānām hita kāṃyayā |
rājño daśarathasya tvam ayodhya adhipateḥ vibhoḥ
dharmajñasya vadānyasya maharṣi sama tejasaḥ |
asya bhāryāsu tisṛṣu hrī śrī kīrti upamāsu ca
viṣṇo putratvam āgaccha kṛtvā ātmānam caturvidham |
verses.translation: "Oh! Vishnu, desiring prosperity in all the worlds we nominate you to become the son of the ruler and lord of Ayodhya, namely Dasharatha, who is a virtuous one, renowned one and one whose resplendence equals that of the sages, and oh, Vishnu, through the wives of such a king Dasharatha, who are in similitude with the hrii, the virtue, shrii, the affluence, and kiirti, the glory, you have a fourfold transformation and take birth as their son.
notes: These three hrī, śrī, kīrti are the daughters of Daksha Prajapati in their earlier births. The hrī is hṛllekha , virtuous disposition - which Queen Kausalya has, and who begot Rama. The śrī is śrīkāra , the affluence of everything, which Queen Sumitra has, by which alone she magnificently and unhesitatingly advises her son Lakshmana to go along with Rama to woods. And the third, kīrti, the glory, and the glory of Kaika is well known. The position of this epic minus Kaika can be imagined, thereby her glory, may it be negative, that may be imagined.

glosses.meaning: you, to Ayodhya's, ruler, lord of
of that virtuous one, renowned one
yourself, four, fold, on making [on transforming yourself]

verses.devanagari:
तत्र त्वं मानुषो भूत्वा प्रवृद्धं लोककण्टकम्
अवध्यं दैवतैर्विष्णो समरे जहि रावणम् |
verses.iast:
tatra tvam mānuṣo bhūtvā pravṛddham loka kaṇṭakam
avadhyam daivataiḥ viṣṇo samare jahi rāvaṇam |
verses.translation: "Oh! Vishnu, on your taking birth as human through the wives of Dasharatha you eliminate Ravana in war, who has become exacerbating and thorny to all worlds, and who is otherwise not eliminable for gods.

glosses.meaning: as human, on becoming, taking birth
to worlds, one who is thorny

verses.devanagari:
स हि देवान् सगन्धर्वान् सिद्धांश्च ऋषिसत्तमान्
राक्षसो रावणो मूर्खो वीर्योद्रेकेण बाधते |
verses.iast:
sa hi devān sa gandharvān siddhān ca ṛṣi sattamān
rākṣaso rāvaṇo mūrkho vīrya udrekeṇa bādhate |
verses.translation: "He that preposterous demon Ravana with his invigorated doggedness is torturing gods along with eminent saints, gandharva-s, and siddha-s.

glosses.itrans: sa gandharvaan siddhaam cha R^iSi sattamaan
glosses.iast: sa gandharvān siddhām ca ṛṣi sattamān
glosses.devanagari: स गन्धर्वान् सिद्धां च ऋषि सत्तमान्
glosses.meaning: with, gandharva celestials, souls of salvation, hermits, eminent ones

verses.devanagari:
ऋषयश्च ततस्तेन गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा
क्रीडन्तो नन्दनवने रौद्रेण विनिपातिताः |
verses.iast:
ṛṣayaḥ ca tataḥ tena gandharvā apsarasaḥ tathā
krīḍayanto nandana vane raiudreṇa vinipātitāḥ |
verses.translation: "He that furious one with his insolence is knocking down sages from their celestial abodes, and like that he is knocking down the gandharva-s and apsara celestials too from the heavenly gardens Nandana, where they will be taking delight.

glosses.meaning: in Nandana, gardens[Heavenly gardens,] those that are delighting

verses.devanagari:
वधार्थं वयमायातास्तस्य वै मुनिभिः सह
सिद्धगन्धर्वयक्षाश्च ततस्त्वां शरणं गताः |
verses.iast:
vadhārtham vayam āyātāḥ tasya vai munibhiḥ saha
siddha gandharva yaxāḥ ca tataḥ tvām śraraṇam gatāḥ |
verses.translation: "We the celestial beings like siddha-s, gandharva-s, yaksha-s along with sages have actually come for his elimination, and thereby we seek shelter in you.

glosses.meaning: siddha-s, gandharva-s, yaksha-s - the celestial beings
for his, elimination, for purpose of, we have come, actually
thereby, [we all] in you, shelter, we have gone in.

verses.devanagari:
त्वं गतिः परमा देव सर्वेषां नः परंतप
वधाय देवशतॄणां नृणां लोके मनः कुरु |
verses.iast:
tvam gatiḥ paramā deva sarveṣām naḥ parantapaḥ
vadhāya deva śatṝṇām nṛṇām loke manaḥ kuru |
verses.translation: "Oh, enemy tormentor, oh, Vishnu, you are the ultimate recourse for all us in eliminating enemies of divinity, hence you make up your mind to take birth in human world." The gods appealed to Vishnu that way.

verses.devanagari:
एवं स्तुतस्तु देवेशो विष्णुस्त्रिदशपुंगवः
पितामहपुरोगांस्तान् सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः
अब्रवीत् त्रिदशान् सर्वान् समेतान् धर्मसंहितान्
verses.iast:
evam stutastu deveśo viṣṇuḥ tridaśaḥ puṅgavaḥ
pitāmaha purogān tān sarva loka namaskṛtaḥ
abravīt tridaśān sarvān sametān dharma saṃhitān
verses.translation: When the god of gods Vishnu, the supreme one among deities, one who is revered by all worlds is eulogised this way, then he spoke to all of those celestials that abide in the righteousness and that are in the assemblage, keeping the Forefather Brahma at their helm.

glosses.meaning: to those that are in assemblage
Forefather - Brahma, keeping ahead - at helm of affairs

verses.devanagari:
भयं त्यजत भद्रं वो हितार्थं युधि रावणम् |
सपुत्रपौत्रं सामात्यं समित्रज्ञातिबान्धवम्
हत्वा क्रूरं दुराधर्षं देवर्षीणां भयावहम् |
दश वर्ष सहस्राणि दश वर्ष शतानि च
वत्स्यामि मानुषे लोके पालयन् पृथिवीमिमाम् |
verses.iast:
bhayam tyajata bhadram vo hitārtham yudhi rāvaṇam |
sa putra pautram sa amātyam sa mitra jñāti bāndhavam
hatvā krūram durādharṣam deva ṛṣIṇām bhayāvaham |
daśa varṣa sahasrāṇi daśa varṣa śatāni ca
vatsyāmi mānuṣe loke pālayan pṛdhvIm imām |
verses.translation: "Get rid off the fear, let safety be upon you, on eliminating that cruel and evil-minded Ravana who became dreadful to deities and sages, along with his sons, grandsons, friends, cousins and relatives, ministers and forces too in war for your welfare, I will then reside in human world ruling this earth for eleven thousand years." Thus Vishnu assured the gods.

glosses.meaning: along with, his friends, cousins, and relatives
for deities, and sages, dreadful one
in human, world, I will reside.

verses.devanagari:
एवं दत्वा वरं देवो देवानां विष्णुरात्मवान्
मानुषे चिन्तयामास जन्मभूमिमथात्मनः |
verses.iast:
evam datvā varam devo devānām viṣṇuḥ ātmavān
mānuṣe cintayāmāsa janmabhUmim atha ātmanaḥ |
verses.translation: On giving boon to all gods in that way the kind-hearted god Vishnu started to think about the instituting base for his birth in human world.

glosses.meaning: to gods, this way, boon, on giving
birth, base [instituting point,] started to think of.

verses.devanagari:
ततः पद्मपलाशाक्षः कृत्वात्मानं चतुर्विधम्
पितरं रोचयामास तदा दशरथं नृपम् |
verses.iast:
tataḥ padma palāśāxaḥ kṛtvā ātmānam catu.rvidham
pitaram rocayāmāsa tadā daśaratham nṛpam |
verses.translation: And then that lotus-petal-eyed one agreeing to manifest himself in fourfold way is predisposed towards Dasharatha to be his father.
notes: There is a great lot of discussion whether Vishnu made himself fourfold as Rama, Lakshmana, Bharata an Shatrughna, or he himself incarnated along with his main ingredients like conch shell, disc, mace as those three brothers. This verse says that he 'made himself, or agreed to make himself as fourfold.' Even then, there are discussions that Rama is a 'full incarnation' pūrṇa avatāra as the Supreme is indivisible - on one account. And his brothers cannot be reckoned as his incarnation as they become parts of the whole but not the 'whole' itself he did not divide himself on the other account. And the tradition believes that Vishnu did not divide himself but incarnated in one piece, where his brothers are his paraphernalia. There is no unanimity on this, as yet.

glosses.meaning: himself, into four-fold, on making [agreeing to make]
as his father, predisposed to select.

verses.devanagari:
तदा देवर्षिगन्धर्वाः सरुद्राः साप्सरो गणाः |
स्तुतिभिर्दिव्यरूपाभिस्तुष्टुवुर्मधुसूदनम्
verses.iast:
tadā deva ṛṣi gandharvāḥ sa rudrāḥ sa apsaro gaṇāḥ |
stutibhiḥ divya rUpābhiḥ tuṣṭuvuḥ madhusUdanam
verses.translation: Then all the groups of gods, sages, gandharva-s, with rudraa-s, and apsarasa-s, extolled Vishnu with prayers of divine exposition. [1-15-32b, c]
notes: Vishnu in early times killed a ghastly demon called Madhu and his brother Kaitabha, hence He is also called Madhusuudana. This is one the thousand names of Vishnu.

glosses.itrans: R^iSi gandharvaaH sa rudraaH sa apsarasaaH ganaaH
glosses.iast: ṛṣi gandharvāḥ sa rudrāḥ sa apsarasāḥ ganāḥ
glosses.devanagari: ऋषि गन्धर्वाः स रुद्राः स अप्सरसाः गनाः
glosses.meaning: with sages, with gandharva-s, with rudra-s, apsara-s, groups of
divine, in form [in exposition,] with prayers
Madhu [the demon,] killer of i.e., Vishnu is

verses.devanagari:
तमुद्धतं रावणमुग्रतेजसम्
प्रवृद्धदर्पं त्रिदशेश्वरद्विषम् |
विरावणं साधुतपस्विकण्टकम्
तपस्विनामुद्धर तं भयावहम्
verses.iast:
tam uddhatam rāvaṇam ugra tejasam
pravṛddha darpam tridaśeśvara vara dviṣam |
virāvaṇam sādhu tapasvi kaṇṭakam
tapasvinām uddhara tam bhayāavaham
verses.translation: "Oh! Vishnu, he that fiery one who is renowned for evil acts and who is the hater of Indra, that Ravana is uprising furiously with his heightened arrogance, and he has become a thorn in the side of hermits hence he is a fright to sages, afor he torturesd insubordinates to the the extent of loud wailing; hence we pray you to eliminate that Ravana."

glosses.meaning: [one who makes everyone to] high, wails
to sages, a thorn in sides
for hermits, he who is a fright
such as he is - him, that Ravana, eliminate [give final emancipation, deliver him from curse] .

verses.devanagari:
तमेव हत्वा सबलं सबान्धवम्
विरावणं रावणमुग्रपौरुषम् |
स्वर्लोकमागच्छ गतज्वरश्चिरम्
सुरेन्द्रगुप्तं गतदोषकल्मषम्
verses.iast:
tameva hatvā sa balam sa bāndhavam
virāvaṇam rāvaṇam ugra pauruṣam |
svar lokam āgaccha gata jvaraḥ ciram
surendra guptam gata doṣa kalmaṣam
verses.translation: "On eliminating that furiously vainglorious Ravana with all his forces and with all his kinsmen neutralise the pandemonium created by him in all the worlds, and for a long time to come you get rid of your febrility, and you please return to your heavenly abode, namely your blameless and faultless Vaikuntha.

glosses.meaning: with all his forces, with all his kinsmen
for a long time to come
for gods, lord - by Indra, made inaccessible, safeguarded
[and one which is] rid of, flaws and blemishes
